fullScope.assessment: Eight published commits; the original two are preserved, followed by an additive master merge and three maintained test changes, a focused manual-collision review fix and its public-contract documentation. The merge first-parent diff brings 100 paths already on actual master; its second-parent diff is exactly the original 14-file translation change. These are necessary target integration, not sibling imports. Net actual-master scope: nine product files and six maintained regression files. No development/evidence artifacts enter product commits. PR35 prompt extraction, release retirement42 and Calibrate remain excluded.
